description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableJsonPointer class, which is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It tests behaviors such as pointer creation, equality, sub-pointer extraction, immutability, and string parsing, including edge cases with slashes and escape sequences.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonPointerTest
classes.description: A comprehensive set of unit tests for the ImmutableJsonPointer class, covering creation, parsing, equality, iteration, immutability, sub-pointer extraction, and edge cases involving escapes and delimiters.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableJsonPointer instances are immutable and their fields are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode and equals for ImmutableJsonPointer.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithLeadingSlash
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonPointer from a string with a leading slash and verifies the level count.

methods.name: createInstanceFromSlash
methods.description: Creates an empty pointer from '/' and verifies it is empty.

methods.name: emptyPointerEqualsPointerWithOneSlash
methods.description: Checks that an empty pointer equals a pointer created with a slash.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithTrailingSlash
methods.description: Creates a pointer from a string with a trailing slash and verifies level count.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithTwoDelimitingSlashes
methods.description: Verifies exception handling when creating pointer with consecutive slashes.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithTwoStartingSlashes
methods.description: Verifies exception handling for pointers starting with multiple slashes.

methods.name: createInstanceFromStringWithTwoEndingSlashes
methods.description: Verifies exception handling for pointers ending with multiple slashes.

methods.name: assertConsecutiveSlashesExceptionFor
methods.description: Helper method that asserts an exception is thrown for invalid consecutive slashes.

methods.name: getReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests retrieval of specific levels from the pointer.

methods.name: getLevelsCountReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the level count retrieval.

methods.name: tryToParseNullString
methods.description: Tests that parsing null string throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: parseSlashDelimitedStringToGetAJsonPointerInstance
methods.description: Tests parsing of slash-delimited string to JsonPointer.

methods.name: iterationWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that iteration over JsonPointer elements works correctly.

methods.name: iteratorIsImmutable
methods.description: Ensures that the iterator throws if modification is attempted.

methods.name: addingNewLevelReturnsNewJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests adding a new level yields a new pointer with extended levels.

methods.name: tryToAddNullLeaf
methods.description: Verifies that adding null leaf throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceFromRootPointer
methods.description: Tests creation of a root (empty) pointer.

methods.name: getSubPointerWithNegativeLevelNumber
methods.description: Checks that requesting a sub-pointer with negative index returns empty.

methods.name: getSubPointerWithTooHighLevelNumberReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Verifies that requesting an out-of-range sub-pointer returns empty.

methods.name: getSubPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests extracting a valid sub-pointer at a specific level.

methods.name: createPointerWithOrWithoutLeadingSlashIsTheSame
methods.description: Asserts equivalence of pointers created with or without leading slash.

methods.name: cutLeafWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that cutLeaf removes the last segment correctly.

methods.name: appendSubPointerReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests appending a sub-pointer results in correct string representation.

methods.name: appendEmptySubPointerReturnsSamePointer
methods.description: Ensures appending an empty pointer returns the original.

methods.name: createInstanceFromParsedStringWithEscapedTildesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests parsing of escape sequences (~0) in pointer segments.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonKeysWithEscapedTildesAndSlashesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies string representation with escape sequences for JSON keys.
